scope: PR43 service-owned paste admission and negotiated compatibility; background macOS checks only.

contract.attach_capability: 0x20; legacy fallback removes this before phase/link bits
contract.hello: 52-byte legacy; 56 bytes with requested paste capability word1
contract.request: attachment40 + request ID u64 + submit flag u8 + raw bytes <=983040
contract.result: attachment40 + request ID u64 + queued flag u8 + UTF-8 message <=4096 bytes
contract.admission: Service-current terminal encoding; one PtyProcess::writeBytes call for entire paste plus optional Enter. Refusal does not write part of a paste or disconnect the view.
contract.limits: Eight pending client requests, ten-second response timeout, monotonic per-attachment IDs, no automatic replay; lost delivery is explicitly unknown.
contract.compatibility: Old clients receive legacy Hello. New clients downgrade against old services, keep small pastes and visibly refuse unsupported larger pastes.
